Dear Supervisory Stakeholder,

ECB Banking Supervision Weekly Bulletin - Week 6/2026

Key Updates:

1. SUPERVISORY PRIORITIES 2026 - IMPLEMENTATION GUIDANCE
The SSM Supervisory Board has published implementation guidance for the 2026-2027 supervisory cycle. Key focus areas include:
- Climate and environmental risk integration into ICAAP processes (deadline: Q3 2026 for significant institutions)
- Enhanced monitoring of CRE exposures in light of persistent valuation pressures
- Operational resilience testing requirements for digital banking channels

2. BASEL IV OUTPUT FLOOR - TRANSITIONAL REPORTING REQUIREMENTS
Following EBA technical standards published March 2026, the ECB confirms that significant institutions must submit parallel output floor calculations starting Q2 2026 reporting cycle (June 30 reference date). The 50% floor applies from January 1, 2025 with 5% annual increases through 2030.

3. SREP 2026 METHODOLOGY UPDATE
Minor refinements to the SREP capital guidance framework will be communicated to institutions by end-February. No material changes to Pillar 2 Requirement calculation methodology are anticipated.

Full bulletin: https://bankingsupervision.europa.eu/press/publications/newsletter/2026/html/ssm.nl260214.en.html

subject: EBA Technical Update - Draft RTS on Green Asset Ratio Disclosure (Feb 2026)
body:
EBA Technical Standards Update - February 2026

The European Banking Authority has published for consultation:

DRAFT REGULATORY TECHNICAL STANDARDS - Green Asset Ratio Disclosure Requirements
(EBA/CP/2026/03)

Key provisions:
- Standardized GAR calculation methodology for Pillar 3 disclosure (aligned with Article 8 Taxonomy Regulation)
- Mandatory disclosure timeline: Large institutions (>€30bn assets) from December 31, 2026; all other institutions from June 30, 2027
- Transitional provisions for taxonomy-eligible vs taxonomy-aligned asset classification
- Enhanced granularity requirements for sectoral breakdown (real estate, manufacturing, energy, transport)

Consultation period: February 11 - April 15, 2026

The final standards are expected to be published Q3 2026 with application from year-end 2026 reporting.

Relevance for supervised institutions:
This directly impacts capital allocation strategies for banks with significant corporate lending portfolios. Institutions should begin assessing current loan book taxonomy alignment to identify disclosure gaps.

Full consultation paper: https://eba.europa.eu/regulation-and-policy/single-rulebook/interactive-single-rulebook/cp202603

Effective April 1, 2026, all EU significant institutions must submit parallel Basel IV output floor calculations alongside existing CRR/CRD IV reports. Technical specifications published in EBA/RTS/2026/03. First submission deadline: April 30, 2026.

ECB confirms 2026 climate risk stress test will include green asset ratio disclosure requirements per draft EBA standards. Participating banks: all EU G-SIBs plus 15 selected O-SIIs including UniCredit, Intesa Sanpaolo, BNP Paribas.

ECB reiterates 2026 focus areas: (a) credit risk from commercial real estate exposures, (b) operational resilience and cyber risk, (c) climate and environmental risks, (d) business model sustainability.
